test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I am not too eager to read that book being that it has not got good reviews.
solution: The correct answer is- '**being that**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the above-given sentence, the error is in the use of the phrase**'being that.'** • **"Being that"** is a** colloquial phrase** that should not be used in formal language or standard written English. • Use "**because**" or "**since**" instead. • Thus, in the given sentence,** 'being that'** should be replaced by '**since**' or '**because**'. • Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.** **Correct Sentence - ***I am not too eager to read that book **because** it has not got good reviews.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • ऊपर दिए गए वाक्य में त्रुटि वाक्यांश 'being that' के प्रयोग में है। • "Being that" एक **बोलचाल **का **वाक्यांश **है जिसका उपयोग **औपचारिक भाषा या मानक लिखित अंग्रेजी में नहीं किया जाना चाहिए**। • इसके बजाय "because" या "since" का प्रयोग करें। • इस प्रकार, दिए गए वाक्य में, 'being that' को 'since' या 'because' से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए। • अतः सही उत्तर** विकल्प 3** है। 93:Tbb4, The correct answer is- 'Incorrigible.'
